<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>CorndogAtbp — Order Online</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#fff8f0; --surface:#ffffff; --text:#2a1a0f; --muted:#8a7363;
  --accent:#ff6b1a; --accent-dark:#e85a0c; --accent-light:#fff0e3;
  --border:#f1e2d3; --good:#2e9e5b;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#1c1410; --surface:#2a2019; --text:#f5ece3; --muted:#c2a996;
    --accent:#ff7a2e; --accent-dark:#ff6b1a; --accent-light:#3a271a;
    --border:#3c2e22; --good:#4cc488;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#1c1410; --surface:#2a2019; --text:#f5ece3; --muted:#c2a996;
  --accent:#ff7a2e; --accent-dark:#ff6b1a; --accent-light:#3a271a;
  --border:#3c2e22; --good:#4cc488;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);}
body{
  font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--accent);z-index:30;}
header{
  position:sticky; top:0; padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  background:var(--accent); color:#fff; z-index:20;
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
}
.header-inner{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 16px;}
.brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
.brand-logo{font-size:26px;}
.brand h1{font-size:19px; margin:0; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.3px;}
.brand small{display:block; font-size:11px; opacity:.9; font-weight:500;}
.loc-btn{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); border:none; color:#fff; border-radius:20px;
  padding:7px 12px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; display:flex; gap:5px; align-items:center;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.cart-btn{
  position:relative; background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); border:none; color:#fff;
  width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; font-size:18px; cursor:pointer;
}
.cart-badge{
  position:absolute; top:-4px; right:-4px; background:#fff; color:var(--accent-dark);
  font-size:11px; font-weight:800; min-width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:9px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 4px;
}
.tabs{display:flex; gap:8px; padding:0 16px 12px;}
.tab{
  flex:1; text-align:center; padding:9px 0; border-radius:20px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.15); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; border:none;
}
.tab.active{background:#fff; color:var(--accent-dark);}
main{max-width:720px; margin:0 auto; padding:16px 14px 100px;}
.section-title{font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:var(--accent-dark); margin:18px 4px 10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px;}
.grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px;}
.card{
  background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; padding:12px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;
}
.card-icon{
  width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; border-radius:12px; background:var(--accent-light);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:34px; overflow:hidden;
}
.card-icon img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;}
.card h3{margin:0; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.25;}
.price-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:6px; margin-top:auto;}
.price{font-weight:800; color:var(--accent-dark); font-size:13.5px;}
select.variant{
  font-size:11px; padding:4px 6px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
}
.add-btn{
  background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:10px; font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700; padding:7px 0; cursor:pointer; width:100%;
}
.add-btn:active{background:var(--accent-dark);}
/* Cart drawer */
.overlay{position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,.4); z-index:40; display:none;}
.overlay.open{display:block;}
.drawer{
  position:fixed; top:0; right:0; bottom:0; width:min(380px,92vw); background:var(--surface);
  z-index:50; transform:translateX(100%); transition:transform .25s ease; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
.drawer.open{transform:translateX(0);}
.drawer-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.drawer-head h2{margin:0; font-size:17px;}
.close-btn{background:none; border:none; font-size:22px; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer;}
.drawer-body{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:12px 16px;}
.cart-item{display:flex; gap:10px; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.cart-item-icon{width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent-light); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:22px; flex-shrink:0;}
.cart-item-info{flex:1; min-width:0;}
.cart-item-info h4{margin:0 0 2px; font-size:13.5px;}
.cart-item-info span{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted);}
.qty-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:6px;}
.qty-btn{width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-size:14px; cursor:pointer;}
.qty-num{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; min-width:16px; text-align:center;}
.remove-btn{margin-left:auto; background:none; border:none; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:underline;}
.empty-msg{text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; padding:40px 10px;}
.drawer-foot{padding:14px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
.subtotal-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:10px;}
.primary-btn{
  width:100%; background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:12px;
  padding:13px 0; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer;
}
.primary-btn:disabled{opacity:.5;}
/* checkout */
.checkout-body label{display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); margin:12px 0 5px;}
.checkout-body input, .checkout-body textarea{
  width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-size:13.5px; font-family:inherit;
}
.toggle-row{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:4px;}
.toggle-btn{flex:1; padding:9px 0; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-weight:700; font-size:12.5px; cursor:pointer;}
.toggle-btn.active{background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border-color:var(--accent);}
.order-summary{background:var(--accent-light); border-radius:12px; padding:12px; margin-top:14px; font-size:12.5px;}
.order-summary div{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:2px 0;}
.hidden{display:none !important;}
.confirm-wrap{text-align:center; padding:30px 20px;}
.confirm-wrap .emoji{font-size:48px;}
.confirm-wrap h2{margin:10px 0 4px;}
.order-num{display:inline-block; background:var(--accent-light); color:var(--accent-dark); font-weight:800; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:20px; margin:10px 0; font-size:13px;}
.msg-box{
  background:var(--bg); border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:10px;
  font-size:11.5px; text-align:left; white-space:pre-wrap; color:var(--muted); margin:14px 0; max-height:160px; overflow-y:auto;
}
.fb-btn{background:#0866ff;}
.cash-note{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--good); font-weight:700; margin-top:6px;}
footer{text-align:center; padding:20px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted);}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="header-inner">
    <div class="brand">
      <span class="brand-logo">🌭</span>
      <div><h1>CorndogAtbp</h1><small>Old Balara, Quezon City</small></div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
      <button class="loc-btn" onclick="openMap()">📍 Directions</button>
      <button class="cart-btn" onclick="toggleCart(true)">🛒<span class="cart-badge" id="cartBadge">0</span></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" id="tabFood" onclick="switchTab('food')">🥪 Food & Snacks</button>
    <button class="tab" id="tabDrinks" onclick="switchTab('drinks')">🥤 Coffee & Drinks</button>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <div id="menuRoot"></div>
</main>

<footer>89 Ilang-Ilang St., Feria Rd., Old Balara, Quezon City · Cash on delivery/pickup</footer>

<!-- Cart Drawer -->
<div class="overlay" id="overlay" onclick="closeAll()"></div>
<div class="drawer" id="cartDrawer">
  <div class="drawer-head"><h2>Your Cart</h2><button class="close-btn" onclick="toggleCart(false)">✕</button></div>
  <div class="drawer-body" id="cartBody"></div>
  <div class="drawer-foot">
    <div class="subtotal-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span id="cartSubtotal">₱0</span></div>
    <button class="primary-btn" id="checkoutBtn" onclick="openCheckout()" disabled>Proceed to Checkout</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Checkout Drawer -->
<div class="drawer" id="checkoutDrawer">
  <div class="drawer-head"><h2>Checkout</h2><button class="close-btn" onclick="closeAll()">✕</button></div>
  <div class="drawer-body checkout-body">
    <label>Full Name</label>
    <input id="custName" placeholder="Juan Dela Cruz">
    <label>Phone Number (for the rider to call)</label>
    <input id="custPhone" placeholder="09XX XXX XXXX" type="tel">
    <label>Delivery or Pick-up?</label>
    <div class="toggle-row">
      <button class="toggle-btn active" id="btnDelivery" onclick="setMode('delivery')">🛵 Delivery</button>
      <button class="toggle-btn" id="btnPickup" onclick="setMode('pickup')">🏪 Pick-up</button>
    </div>
    <div id="addressWrap">
      <label>Delivery Address</label>
      <textarea id="custAddress" rows="2" placeholder="House/Unit No., Street, Barangay"></textarea>
    </div>
    <label>Order Notes (optional)</label>
    <textarea id="custNotes" rows="2" placeholder="e.g. less sugar, extra sauce"></textarea>
    <div class="order-summary" id="checkoutSummary"></div>
    <div class="cash-note">💵 Cash on delivery/pick-up — no online payment needed</div>
  </div>
  <div class="drawer-foot">
    <button class="primary-btn" onclick="placeOrder()">Place Order</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Confirmation Drawer -->
<div class="drawer" id="confirmDrawer">
  <div class="drawer-head"><h2>Order Summary</h2><button class="close-btn" onclick="closeAll()">✕</button></div>
  <div class="drawer-body confirm-wrap">
    <div class="emoji">✅</div>
    <h2>Almost done!</h2>
    <p style="color:var(--muted); font-size:13px;">Messenger should open automatically. Just paste your order and send it. If it didn't open, tap the button below.</p>
    <div class="order-num" id="orderNumDisplay"></div>
    <div class="msg-box" id="orderText"></div>
    <a class="primary-btn fb-btn" href="https://m.me/CorndogAtbp" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="copyOrder()" style="display:block;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;">📋 Copy & Open Messenger</a>
    <p id="copiedNote" style="font-size:11.5px; color:var(--good); font-weight:700; height:16px;"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const IMAGES = {
  ube_latte: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  overlods: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  strawberry_matcha: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  strawberry_milk: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  korean_bimbowl: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  oreo_latte: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  caramel_macchiato: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  ginger_lemon: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  matcha_latte: "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
};
const MENU = {
  food: [
    {n:"OverLods Tapa Kanin", p:100, i:"🍚", img:"overlods"},
    {n:"Korean BimBowl", p:170, i:"🍚", img:"korean_bimbowl"}
  ],
  drinks: [
    {n:"Caramel Macchiato", lo:89, hi:99, i:"☕", img:"caramel_macchiato"},
    {n:"Oreo Latte", lo:99, hi:109, i:"🍪", img:"oreo_latte"},
    {n:"Ube Latte", lo:89, hi:99, i:"💜", img:"ube_latte"},
    {n:"Strawberry Milk", lo:89, hi:99, i:"🍓", img:"strawberry_milk"},
    {n:"Matcha Latte", lo:89, hi:99, i:"🍵", img:"matcha_latte"},
    {n:"Strawberry Matcha (Large)", p:99, i:"🍓", img:"strawberry_matcha"},
    {n:"Ginger Lemon", lo:89, hi:99, i:"🍋", img:"ginger_lemon"}
  ]
};
const FB_LINK = "https://m.me/CorndogAtbp";
const SHOP_ADDRESS = "89 Ilang-Ilang St., Feria Rd., Old Balara, Quezon City";

let cart = []; // {name, price, qty, icon}
let orderMode = 'delivery';

function renderMenu(tab){
  const root = document.getElementById('menuRoot');
  root.innerHTML = '';
  const title = document.createElement('div');
  title.className = 'section-title';
  title.textContent = tab === 'food' ? 'Food & Snacks' : 'Coffee & Drinks';
  root.appendChild(title);
  const grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'grid';
  MENU[tab].forEach((item, idx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'card';
    const hasRange = item.lo !== undefined;
    const selId = `sel-${tab}-${idx}`;
    const media = item.img
      ? `<div class="card-icon"><img src="${IMAGES[item.img]}" alt="${item.n}" loading="lazy"></div>`
      : `<div class="card-icon">${item.i}</div>`;
    card.innerHTML = `
      ${media}
      <h3>${item.n}</h3>
      ${hasRange
        ? `<select class="variant" id="${selId}"><option value="${item.lo}">Regular — ₱${item.lo}</option><option value="${item.hi}">Large — ₱${item.hi}</option></select>`
        : `<div class="price">₱${item.p}</div>`}
      <button class="add-btn" onclick="addToCart('${item.n.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}', ${hasRange ? `document.getElementById('${selId}').value` : item.p}, '${item.i}', ${item.img ? `'${IMAGES[item.img]}'` : "''"})">Add to Cart</button>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
  root.appendChild(grid);
}

function switchTab(tab){
  document.getElementById('tabFood').classList.toggle('active', tab==='food');
  document.getElementById('tabDrinks').classList.toggle('active', tab==='drinks');
  renderMenu(tab);
}

function addToCart(name, price, icon, img){
  price = Number(price);
  const existing = cart.find(c => c.name === name && c.price === price);
  if(existing){ existing.qty++; } else { cart.push({name, price, qty:1, icon, img}); }
  updateCartUI();
}

function changeQty(idx, delta){
  cart[idx].qty += delta;
  if(cart[idx].qty <= 0) cart.splice(idx,1);
  updateCartUI();
}
function removeItem(idx){ cart.splice(idx,1); updateCartUI(); }

function updateCartUI(){
  const count = cart.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.qty,0);
  document.getElementById('cartBadge').textContent = count;
  const body = document.getElementById('cartBody');
  const subtotal = cart.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.qty*c.price,0);
  document.getElementById('cartSubtotal').textContent = `₱${subtotal}`;
  document.getElementById('checkoutBtn').disabled = cart.length === 0;
  if(cart.length === 0){
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-msg">Your cart is empty.<br>Add something tasty! 🌭</div>`;
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = cart.map((c,idx) => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <div class="cart-item-icon">${c.img ? `<img src="${c.img}" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;">` : c.icon}</div>
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <h4>${c.name}</h4>
        <span>₱${c.price} each</span>
        <div class="qty-row">
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${idx},-1)">−</button>
          <span class="qty-num">${c.qty}</span>
          <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${idx},1)">+</button>
          <button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeItem(${idx})">Remove</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function toggleCart(open){
  document.getElementById('cartDrawer').classList.toggle('open', open);
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.toggle('open', open);
}
function closeAll(){
  ['cartDrawer','checkoutDrawer','confirmDrawer'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('open'));
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open');
}
function openCheckout(){
  toggleCart(false);
  document.getElementById('checkoutDrawer').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('open');
  renderCheckoutSummary();
}
function setMode(mode){
  orderMode = mode;
  document.getElementById('btnDelivery').classList.toggle('active', mode==='delivery');
  document.getElementById('btnPickup').classList.toggle('active', mode==='pickup');
  document.getElementById('addressWrap').classList.toggle('hidden', mode==='pickup');
}
function renderCheckoutSummary(){
  const subtotal = cart.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.qty*c.price,0);
  document.getElementById('checkoutSummary').innerHTML =
    cart.map(c=>`<div><span>${c.qty}x ${c.name}</span><span>₱${c.qty*c.price}</span></div>`).join('') +
    `<div style="font-weight:800; border-top:1px solid var(--border); margin-top:6px; padding-top:6px;"><span>Total</span><span>₱${subtotal}</span></div>`;
}

function genOrderNumber(){
  const d = new Date();
  return 'CA-' + d.getFullYear().toString().slice(2) + (d.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0') + d.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0') + '-' + Math.floor(100+Math.random()*900);
}

function placeOrder(){
  const name = document.getElementById('custName').value.trim();
  const phone = document.getElementById('custPhone').value.trim();
  const address = document.getElementById('custAddress').value.trim();
  const notes = document.getElementById('custNotes').value.trim();
  if(!name || !phone){ alert('Please enter your name and phone number.'); return; }
  if(orderMode === 'delivery' && !address){ alert('Please enter your delivery address.'); return; }

  const orderNum = genOrderNumber();
  const subtotal = cart.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.qty*c.price,0);
  let text = `🌭 CorndogAtbp Order\nOrder #: ${orderNum}\n\n`;
  cart.forEach(c => { text += `${c.qty}x ${c.name} — ₱${c.qty*c.price}\n`; });
  text += `\nTotal: ₱${subtotal}\n\n`;
  text += `Name: ${name}\nPhone: ${phone}\n`;
  text += orderMode === 'delivery' ? `Mode: Delivery\nAddress: ${address}\n` : `Mode: Pick-up at store\n`;
  if(notes) text += `Notes: ${notes}\n`;
  text += `Payment: Cash`;

  document.getElementById('orderText').textContent = text;
  document.getElementById('orderNumDisplay').textContent = 'Order #' + orderNum;
  window._pendingOrderText = text;

  closeAll();
  document.getElementById('confirmDrawer').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('open');
  sendToMessenger();
}

function copyOrder(){
  const t = window._pendingOrderText || '';
  const note = document.getElementById('copiedNote');
  note.textContent = 'Order copied! Paste it in the Messenger chat.';
  try{
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).catch(()=>{ note.textContent = 'Select and copy the order above, then paste it in Messenger.'; });
  }catch(e){ note.textContent = 'Select and copy the order above, then paste it in Messenger.'; }
}
function sendToMessenger(){
  copyOrder();
  try{ window.open(FB_LINK, '_blank'); }catch(e){}
}

function openMap(){
  window.open('https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=' + encodeURIComponent(SHOP_ADDRESS), '_blank');
}

renderMenu('food');
updateCartUI();
</script>
</body>
</html>
